instruction: You are facing an open door.  You are going to walk into the house.  And you are going to take an immediate right and walk down the hallway thru the open wood door.  You are going to continue down this hallway passing some stairs on your left.  You are going to see 2 black columns on your right and there is going to be a large open area on your left.  You will see it is a living room.  You are going to head towards the dark grey lounger chair in the middle of this room.  And once next to the grey lounger chair with the book opened laying on it and the coffee table on your right you are going to take 1 step forward towards the round table near the window with a picture on it.  And once you have hopped over the table and you are facing the window looking outside you are done.
